stem: Find the general term of the sequence $\{a_n\}$ determined by the following conditions. $a_3={=p}, \ a_{n+1}=a_n {=op} {=m}$
solution: The relation $a_{n+1}=a_n {=op} {=m}$ means the sequence is arithmetic with common difference {=d}.
Counting from the third term: $a_n = a_3+(n-3)d = {=p}+(n-3)\times({=d})$.
notes: Twist: the given term is a_3, not a_1, so the formula a_1+(n-1)d cannot be applied directly.
